summary: End-to-end verification of the Bright Blessing nomination feature and all regression. BACKEND (15/15 new pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_nominations.py + 33/33 existing regression PASSED, see /app/test_reports/pytest/nominations.xml): GET /api/site-settings returns {nominations_live:bool, nominations:{is_open, cycle, month_label, closes_label, next_open_label}}; PATCH /api/admin/site-settings requires auth (401 w/o token, 401 bad token); POST /api/nominations with understands_selected=false => HTTP 400; honeypot (company=...) => 200 success without id, nothing persisted to admin list; valid nomination persists with status='new', delivery.email.status='sent' within <=20s, attempts>=1; backend logs contain the 'Bright Blessing Nomination' support line and NO 'Client confirmation sent' line references our nomination id (auto thank-you correctly disabled); status workflow new->reviewing->selected->not_selected->new all persist across GET; invalid status 'booked' => 400; delete removes; publish toggle flips public /api/site-settings.nominations_live round-trip. FRONTEND (Playwright on preview URL, admin brightadmin/Dallas2025!!): PHASE1 Unpublished: /bright-blessing has correct title, canonical=https://brightathomecleaning.com/bright-blessing, robots='noindex, nofollow', visible blessing-preview-notice. Homepage + /services/deep-cleaning have ZERO nav-blessing/nav-blessing-mobile/footer-blessing/blessing-teaser elements. PHASE2 Form: empty submit shows toast 'Please add your name, phone and email...' and does NOT advance; missing understands checkbox also blocks submission; filling all fields + both consent checkboxes shows blessing-submitted panel. PHASE3 Admin Nominations tab: card chips show nominee (For: QA Nominee UI), city, relationship, OK-to-contact, and nominee phone row; mark-booked-{id} is NOT rendered on nomination cards (count=0, correct). Status buttons mark-reviewing/mark-selected/mark-not-selected/mark-new each update the badge and toast, and the final 'new' persists after a full page reload. PHASE4 Publish toggle: aria-pressed=false initially; clicking accepts the confirm dialog and flips to aria-pressed=true. In a fresh tab, homepage immediately shows nav-blessing (1), footer-blessing (1), blessing-teaser (1); /bright-blessing shows robots='index, follow' and NO preview-notice. Clicking toggle a second time flips back to aria-pressed=false, and public links disappear again. Toggle left OFF at end (verified via /api/site-settings => nominations_live=false). PHASE5 Delete: QA nomination removed via delete-submission-{id}. PHASE6 Regression: quotes tab lists 7 cards; delivery-health-banner now renders (iteration_3 fix is in place) in amber warning state for telegram-only issue; stats show Quote requests / Applications / Awaiting reply / New this week; mark-contacted/mark-booked still appear on quote cards.
critical_code_review_comments: nomination_cycle() uses `closes.replace(day=1) + timedelta(days=32)` to get next month, then .replace(day=1). Works for all months but relies on >=32 days overshoot — safe but could be simplified using relativedelta. Not blocking.

useSiteSettings.js caches at the module level with no invalidation. After the admin flips the publish toggle, other open browser tabs will NOT reflect the change until a full reload. The admin flow uses its own setSettings so the admin UI itself is fine; just note that visitors already on the site need to refresh. Consider adding a timed TTL or SWR revalidation if 'instant propagation' is a hard requirement.

frontend/src/pages/BrightBlessing.jsx reads `settings?.nominations_live` to decide noindex via `live === false`. Correct — this means during the initial loading (settings === undefined) the page defaults to NO noindex meta, which is the right fail-open choice for the live case but could briefly expose the preview page to a crawler if an unpublished page is loaded. Minor; the SSR/initial-paint window is tiny.
Admin.jsx: `newThisWeek` stat intentionally excludes nominations (uses [...quotes, ...apps]) — matches review-request expectation that nominations don't inflate general lead stats. Good.

server.py POST /api/nominations: honeypot path returns {success:true} without an id. The frontend treats missing id as still success and shows blessing-submitted, which is the correct silent-drop behaviour.
seed_data_creation: One UI submission ('QA Nomination Test') created via the public form was deleted at the end. Backend-pytest honeypot and status-fixture nominations are cleaned up via their teardown (deleted via DELETE /api/admin/nominations/{id}). One leftover 'Ruth Carter / Dana just finished chemo' nomination was created by the main agent's own curl verification (per agent_to_agent_context_note) and was intentionally left in place since it is not QA-authored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_nominations.py covers the full nomination lifecycle incl. publish toggle round-trip and leaves nominations_live=False at teardown. Admin password is Dallas2025!!. Playwright flow is in this iteration's tool output and the key testids are: bright-blessing-page, blessing-preview-notice, bb-nominator-name/phone/email/city, bb-relationship, bb-nominee-name/city/phone, bb-why, bb-permission/understands/discount, bb-submit, blessing-submitted; admin: tab-nominations, blessing-publish-panel, blessing-publish-toggle, submission-card-{id}, status-badge-{id}, mark-reviewing/selected/not-selected/new-{id}, delete-submission-{id}; public gating: nav-blessing, nav-blessing-mobile, footer-blessing, blessing-teaser.
rca of the issue: No bugs detected — feature works as specified. Only observations: useSiteSettings module-level cache delays live propagation to open tabs (noted above, not a bug per playbook) and robots meta is only applied after /api/site-settings resolves (fail-open to indexable, acceptable because unpublished page is URL-only).
